name: Elijah
overview: Elijah, known as Elias in the New Testament, is a prophet whose ministry is affirmed by Jesus as a forerunner figure, particularly in relation to John the Baptist (Matthew 11:14). The disciples recognized Elijah's significance when he appeared with Moses during the Transfiguration of Christ, underscoring his enduring role in God's redemptive plan (Matthew 17:3-4). Jesus' teaching also highlights the prophetic expectation of Elijah's return, emphasizing his pivotal place in biblical prophecy and the fulfillment of God's promises (Matthew 17:10, 16:14).
